For mechanical; the Filco Convertible is a beautiful board with a load of nice features, like how you can connect it to muiltiple PC's/Phones/Tablets and it'll save them as profiles that you can switch between quickly. For non-mechanical; I'm not actually sure what I could recommend. I also use my keyboards from the couch. One thing that made a dramatic difference was simply getting a USB extension cable and plugging the USB receiver into it, then sticking the end to the top of the monitor. Having that line of sight completely eliminated lag/dropped signal, even with my el-cheapo wireless mouse and keyboard.

I think the Rapoo KX is the best option for wireless, and one of the only that lists a range greater than 20 feet.

It has a rechargeable wireless battery, 60% form factor is it's nice and small for a HTPC. The only downside is no Cherry MX switches. It has Kailh Yellow switches which are like Cherry Red, so if you throw some O-rings on the stems and type gently it will be pretty quiet.
